item.question: How does the MLMM approach affect the analysis of Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE)?
item.answer: The MLMM approach affects the analysis of RMSE by allowing direct modeling through a square root link function. It shows negative average effects on RMSE across conditions, with variability depending on correlation strength and sample size.
